title: CHAMPA RICE
sub: In Song China, farmers grew a rice known as Champa rice.
say: In Song China, farmers grew a rice known as Chahm-pah rice.

title: CHAMPA
sub: Champa was a kingdom on the coast of Vietnam.
say: Chahm-pah was a kingdom on the coast of Vietnam.

title: EARLY RICE
sub: Song records describe Champa rice as a variety that ripened early and could survive with less water.
say: Song records describe Chahm-pah rice as a variety that ripened early and could survive with less water.

sub: Song records, as discussed by historian Ho Ping-ti, say that in 1012 the emperor had thirty thousand bushels of its seed shared out.

title: SOUTH ASIA?
sub: But where did it come from first? A 2011 genetic study links these varieties to a rice group from South Asia.

title: THE NAME STUCK
sub: Champa may have been one stop on its journey, but the name stuck.
say: Chahm-pah may have been one stop on its journey, but the name stuck.

title: WHO?
sub: So who were the people whose name ended up in China's rice fields?
